>>R<< BALL BEARING INSTALLATION
1. Check the installation direction of the ball bearing.
2. Using special tools MD998812 and MD998818, press install 
the ball bearing.
>>S<< TAPER ROLLER BEARING INSTALLATION
Using special tools MD998812, MD998819 and MD998364, 
press install the taper roller bearing.
>>T<< SNAP RING INSTALLATION
1. Install the thickest snap ring that can be fitted in the groove 
of output shaft.
2. Make sure that the ball bearing <F5M42> or taper roller 
bearing <F5M51> end play meets the standard value.
Standard value: 0 − 0.09 mm (0 − 0.0035 inch)
